realm.name: ROLE_ADMIN
realm.description: Bank administrator

realm.name: ROLE_OPERATOR
realm.description: Bank operator

realm.name: ROLE_VIEWER
realm.description: Read-only access

realm.name: ROLE_API
realm.description: Machine-to-machine API access

realm.name: ROLE_CONTEXT_INVESTIGATION
realm.description: Dedicated Context-to-Fraud investigation candidate lookup

realm.name: ROLE_KYC
realm.description: KYC officer (legacy — use KYC_OPENER or KYC_REVIEWER for new assignments)

realm.name: ROLE_KYC_OPENER
realm.description: KYC case opener: initiates cases, submits documents, updates checks. Cannot approve/reject (four-eyes, ADR-0116)

realm.name: ROLE_KYC_REVIEWER
realm.description: KYC case reviewer: approves or rejects cases in UNDER_REVIEW. Must be different identity than opener (four-eyes, ADR-0116)

realm.name: ROLE_COMPLIANCE
realm.description: AML/KYC analyst: reads all PII unmasked, raises alerts, freezes accounts

realm.name: ROLE_AUDITOR
realm.description: Read-only access to audit trail (SOX/DORA evidence)

realm.name: ROLE_DPO
realm.description: Data Protection Officer — GDPR Art. 15/20 export endpoints (ADR-0204); no write actions

realm.name: ROLE_SUPERVISOR
realm.description: Approves limit overrides, large payments, board-level escalations

realm.name: ROLE_PAYMENTS
realm.description: Payment ops: initiation, recall, return, clearing reconciliation

realm.name: ROLE_CREDIT_RISK
realm.description: Credit-risk officer: takes the credit decision on a loan application (openbank-lending-service). Declared in @RolesAllowed since the service shipped; created here by issue #2442

realm.name: ROLE_LENDING_OFFICER
realm.description: Lending officer: opens and services loan applications, cannot take the credit decision (four-eyes with ROLE_CREDIT_RISK). Declared in @RolesAllowed since the service shipped; created here by issue #2442

realm.name: ROLE_COMMS_EDITOR
realm.description: Communication Studio maker: drafts and submits style/playbook versions (ADR-0285 D6). Cannot publish (four-eyes with ROLE_COMMS_APPROVER).

realm.name: ROLE_COMMS_APPROVER
realm.description: Communication Studio checker: publishes and retires style/playbook versions and decides commstyle.publish four-eyes approvals (ADR-0285 D3/D6). Never granted to the same person's own draft (application-layer maker!=checker check).

realm.name: ROLE_RISK
realm.description: Risk department (ALM/market risk): reads balance-sheet snapshots, instruments, cash-flow ladders and curve sets in openbank-risk-engine; creates snapshots and uploads curve sets (humans only, ADR-0313/0314). #10618

realm.name: ROLE_FINANCE
realm.description: Finance department (accounting/GL): reads risk-engine snapshots and runs the lending ledger backfill four-eyes flow (propose/approve/execute; maker != checker enforced in lending). #10618

realm.name: ROLE_TREASURY_DEALER
realm.description: Treasury dealer (front office, maker). DECLARED ONLY: no service grants it yet; reserved so treasury SoD (dealer != approver) exists before the first treasury endpoint. #10618

realm.name: ROLE_TREASURY_APPROVER
realm.description: Treasury approver (checker for dealer trades). DECLARED ONLY: no service grants it yet; the four-eyes counterpart of ROLE_TREASURY_DEALER. #10618

realm.name: ROLE_DEMO
realm.description: Demo/guided-tour badge shown by the admin-UI (src/lib/auth/roles.ts). Existed in the live sandbox realm and in the docker dev realm but was missing here, so a cold-started cluster would not have it — added by the #2442 drift reconciliation

openbank-mcp-service.name: mcp-caller
openbank-mcp-service.description: May call MCP tools via an OBO-exchanged token (ADR-0224). Assignment to staff is operational, not realm-managed

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

clientScopes.name: service_account
clientScopes.description: Specific scope for a client enabled for service accounts

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: catalog:read
clientScopes.description: Product Catalog read (issue #7324). product-catalog's CatalogScopeRoleMapper maps this scope to CATALOG_SCOPE_READ. Not a realm default: only a client that lists it receives it.

clients.name: ${client_admin-cli}
clients.description: Keycloak's built-in CLI/direct-grant client, declared explicitly so operator password-grant tokens carry realm_access — left to Keycloak's auto-created default (fullScopeAllowed=false, no scope mappings), it mints no realm roles at all (#5498).

clients.name: OpenBank MCP Service (OBO audience)
clients.description: Audience target for RFC 8693 OBO-exchanged staff tokens (ADR-0224). Token-exchange scope permission granted to openbank-admin-ui only (verified on Keycloak 26.6.3)

clients.name: OpenBank Backend Services
clients.description: Confidential client used by backend services (e.g. account-service) as an OIDC resource server validating bearer tokens.

clients.name: OpenBank Context investigation
clients.description: Dedicated service identity for bounded Fraud case matching; never a human investigator token.

clients.name: OpenBank Customer Edge
clients.description: M2M service-account client for the customer-facing edge proxy (ADR-0065). The edge validates customer JWTs from openbank-customers realm and uses this client (client_credentials) to call upstream backend services with an operator-realm token.

clients.name: OpenBank Interest Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for interest-service's ledger capitalization posts (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; ledger.create is granted by identity in ledger_rest_ext.rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Account Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for account-service's welcome-bonus credit (transaction.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank SDD Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for sdd-service's collection settlement (transaction.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Standing Order Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for standing-order execution (transaction.create, sepaPayment.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank SEPA Payment Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for sepa-payment's settlement leg and R-transaction reversal (transaction.create, transaction.reverse) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Lending Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for lending's borrower credit/debit and loan journals (transaction.create, ledger.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Clearing Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for clearing's net-settlement journal (ledger.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Domestic Payment Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for domestic-payment's settlement booking (transaction.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank SEPA Instant Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for sepa-instant's SCT Inst settlement booking (transaction.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank SWIFT Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for swift-service's MT103 settlement booking (transaction.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Transaction Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for transaction-service's journal post/reverse and cover holds (ledger.create/reverse, balance.hold/holdRelease) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Settlement Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for settlement-service's journal and balance legs (ledger.create/read, balance.debit/credit) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank FX Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for fx-service's AML case open (amlCase.create) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity upstream.

clients.name: OpenBank KYB Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for kyb-service's entity-party create and mandate grant (party.create, party.mandate.grant) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity upstream.

clients.name: OpenBank Analytics Sink
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for analytics-sink's account-registry sweep (account.list) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Billing Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for billing-service's account reads (account.list, account.read) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Document Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for document-service's account lookup (account.list) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Party Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for party-service's GDPR Art. 15 account and transaction reads (account.list, transaction.list) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Copilot Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for copilot-service's credit-profile read (analytics-sink) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; analytics-sink admits it by name.

clients.name: OpenBank Campaign Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for campaign-service's incentive offer read (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; incentive-service admits it by name.

clients.name: OpenBank Delegation Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for delegation-service's party eligibility and card ownership reads (pid party.read, card.read) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity upstream.

clients.name: OpenBank Agent Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for agent-service's charter-gated read tools (transaction.list/read, sctInstPayment.list/read) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity upstream.

clients.name: OpenBank MCP Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for mcp-service's charter-gated read ports (transaction.list) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity upstream.

clients.name: OpenBank Statement Service
clients.description: Per-service M2M client for statement-service's booked-entries search (transaction.search) (issue #10486). Holds ROLE_API only; its actions are granted by identity in the upstream OPA rego.

clients.name: OpenBank Synthetic Journey: Product Catalog read
clients.description: Synthetic-only identity for the product-catalog-read k6 journey (ADR-0252, issue #7324). No realm roles; its only grant is the catalog:read client scope, which product-catalog maps to CATALOG_SCOPE_READ.
